blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — A US federal court on Monday struck down a visa policy implemented by the Trump administration intended to enforce stricter time limits on foreign students and media personnel studying or working in the United States. In his dismissal order, Judge Dennis Saylor condemned the policy as “arbitrary, capricious, an abuse of discretion, […]...
